HTTP · cURL:
Generate License Key(s)

Select a product variant, quantity, and click generate. Your balance will be deducted automatically. The form includes an Idempotency-Key to prevent double charges on retry.

Idempotency active – resubmitting the same form will not charge again.
Quick Tips
  • Ensure sufficient balance before generating.
  • Stock is shown in the dropdown; if zero, generation will fail.
  • Each key is delivered immediately in the response.

Stock Info

Enter a variant ID (you can find it in the product list) to see the current stock count. If the stock is 0, generation will fail with HTTP 409.

Reset Key Devices
About Reset

This resets the HWID/device lock for a license key you have previously purchased. The key must be valid and belong to your reseller account.

Secure server-side calls – token never exposed. Keep this file private and never commit it to public repositories.
